question.text: Which SEBI document is the current consolidated framework on the Social Stock Exchange (SSE), and what is the most recent partial modification?

answer.text: September 2022 framework circular only — no revisions have been issued since
January 2024 circular replacing the 2022 framework entirely
September 2025 circular supplementing the September 2022 framework — this is the latest position
January 19, 2026 Master Circular for the Framework on Social Stock Exchange, partially modified by the April 15, 2026 circular

explanation.text: The Logic: The current consolidated SEBI document on SSE is the Master Circular dated January 19, 2026, with partial modifications notified by the April 15, 2026 circular. The September 2022 and September 2025 circulars are part of the lineage cited by the SIA workbook page 211, but they are no longer the most recent position. The Trap: Selecting "September 2025 is the latest" is the most common distractor — it reflects the workbook citation rather than the Master Circular issued thereafter. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XXIII Topics 3 and 9 lean on the dual 2022/2025 lineage; the January 19, 2026 Master Circular and the April 15, 2026 modification are the current operative documents.
